subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

When it comes to cooking, she can really think __creatively and unconventionally__ to create unique dishes that surprise everyone.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"think creatively and unconventionally"** means to approach problems or tasks in an original and innovative way, often by considering unusual or unconventional solutions. (रचनात्मक और पारंपरिक तरीके से सोचना)

 
 
• **Example:** When it comes to marketing strategies, she always thinks creatively and unconventionally to come up with unique campaigns that stand out.
 
 
 
• **"Think outside the box"** is an idiom that describes the ability to think creatively, unorthodoxly, or from a new perspective. (नए दृष्टिकोण से सोचना)
 
 
• **Example:** Successful entrepreneurs often think outside the box to develop groundbreaking products and services.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate idiom to substitute the underlined segment is **'think outside the box'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Outside the wire** (तार के बाहर): Typically refers to being beyond a secured or safe area, often used in military contexts.

 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers were instructed not to venture outside the wire after dark.
 
 
 
• **Outside the canvas** (कैनवास के बाहर): Not a commonly used idiom, could imply thinking beyond the usual artistic boundaries.
 
 
• **Example:** The artist was known for her unique style, always thinking outside the canvas.
 
 
 
• **Outside the law** (कानून के बाहर): Refers to actions that are illegal or not within the bounds of the law.
 
 
• **Example:** The vigilante operated outside the law, taking justice into his own hands.
 
 

3a:Tcbf,
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
